summary: The source and compiled main pass the parsed iteration count into repeated GPU launches. Each kernel grid-strides over all rows and traverses the complete CSR interval. A pre-timing input copy initializes device arrays; the timed loop performs each launch, stop-event synchronization and result copy follow. Compiled main has a retained loop backedge through the actual launch stub. Final sm86 SASS retains full CSR arithmetic including bulk/tail branches and store.
